responsibility: This header supplies target predefined standard-conformance macros for VxWorks builds in GCC’s configuration layer. It defines floating-point and Unicode-related macros such as __STDC_IEC_559__, __STDC_IEC_559_COMPLEX__, and __STDC_ISO_10646__ to match the guarantees and values exposed by the operating system headers, so front-end preprocessing sees the correct VxWorks platform capabilities without needing to inspect system headers directly.
